Overview.p: Amazon S3 is object storage in AWS. Files are stored as objects in buckets, accessed over HTTPS with an API, and designed for 99.999999999% durability.
A huge online locker. Put any file in, get a link, and never worry about disk space.
A news site stores millions of images in S3 and serves them to users worldwide.

items: A client calls the S3 API over HTTPS
S3 stores the object in the bucket
Data is copied across multiple AZs
You read it back with the key
